en: The postcard features four sepia-tone photographs: three depicting people on horseback or walking through hilly, rural terrain, and one showing the ruins of an ancient temple complex. The text indicates the postcard is themed around travel from Andritsaina to Phigaleia in the Peloponnese region. The final image in the lower right clearly shows an ancient Greek ruin with Doric columns, likely a famous archaeological site.
